Tweet from Winston Peters 


Winston Peters
@winstonpeters
The National Party calling for a referendum on MMP is inexplicable.

MMP broke the stranglehold of two parties running roughshod over our economy without social licence.

Now that the two old parties are losing their grip on power, they want to change the electoral system to favour their falling fortunes.
The public voted for MMP in 1993. The public voted for MMP in 2011.

People want representation in parliament that busts the two old parties’ who are intent on keeping power at all costs and just being happy to continue to manage the decline.

The old parties’ weak and inept attitude to economic sovereignty, immigration, and woke nonsense has seen people move to a party that is offering common sense, patriotism, and old-fashioned Kiwi values.

Shutting down and taking away true democratic representation from the people of New Zealand should be seen for what it is – a power grab and an ignorance for what it means to be a democracy.
